description: This file defines a custom control named CalculationResult for a Windows UWP calculator app. It manages display properties such as font size, margins, and error states, and includes logic for dynamic text scaling and scrolling within the control.

classes.name: CalculationResult
classes.description: A custom control for displaying calculation results with dynamic font scaling, error indication, and scrolling capabilities.

methods.name: UpdateTextState
methods.description: Adjusts the font size and layout of the display text to fit within the control's bounds.

methods.name: GetRawDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the display value with group separators removed, suitable for internal processing.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Initializes control parts and sets up event handlers when the control template is applied.

methods.name: OnTapped
methods.description: Handles tap events to focus and select the control.

methods.name: OnRightTapped
methods.description: Handles right-click or context menu events, focusing the control or its text block.

methods.name: OnCreateAutomationPeer
methods.description: Creates an automation peer for accessibility support.

methods.name: OnIsActivePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual state when the IsActive property changes.

methods.name: OnDisplayValuePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates the displayed text when the DisplayValue property changes.

methods.name: OnIsInErrorPropertyChanged
methods.description: Changes font family to indicate error state.

methods.name: OnMinFontSizePropertyChanged
methods.description: Recalculates text layout when MinFontSize changes.

methods.name: OnMaxFontSizePropertyChanged
methods.description: Recalculates text layout when MaxFontSize changes.

methods.name: OnTextContainerSizeChanged
methods.description: Recalculates text layout when the container size changes.

methods.name: OnTextBlockSizeChanged
methods.description: Updates scroll button visibility when text size changes.

methods.name: OnTextContainerLayoutUpdated
methods.description: Recalculates text layout during layout updates.

methods.name: OnTextContainerOnViewChanged
methods.description: Updates scroll buttons when the view changes.

methods.name: UpdateVisualState
methods.description: Switches visual states based on whether the control is active.

methods.name: OnScrollLeftClick
methods.description: Scrolls the text container to the left.

methods.name: OnScrollRightClick
methods.description: Scrolls the text container to the right.

methods.name: ModifyFontAndMargin
methods.description: Adjusts font size and margin for text scaling.

methods.name: UpdateScrollButtons
methods.description: Shows or hides scroll buttons based on content overflow.

methods.name: ScrollLeft
methods.description: Performs scrolling to the left.

methods.name: ScrollRight
methods.description: Performs scrolling to the right.

methods.name: RaiseSelectedEvent
methods.description: Invokes the Selected event to notify selection.
